visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The opening frame shows a close-up of a person's legs wearing black lace-trimmed stockings and a short black skirt. Four circular portrait icons featuring different young women are arranged around the center. A text overlay in the middle of the frame presents a challenge for the viewer to identify the person based on their legs. (2) The scene shifts to an outdoor garden setting with green grass and potted plants. A person in a black and white maid uniform, black stockings, and black pointed heels walks forward, labeled as number 1. The camera provides a focused view of the stockings' texture and the person's movement. (3) A second person is displayed from the waist down in a similar maid outfit but with white stockings and silver buckle shoes, labeled as number 2. The lighting is bright and natural. (4) A third set of legs is shown, wearing black stockings and black chunky platform heels, labeled as number 4. Each phase highlights specific footwear and legwear details against the garden background. (5) The final phase returns to a graphic layout showing the four girls' portraits with their names listed. It transitions into a promotional graphic with cartoon maid characters and project titles.
